title: “Claude cuts my TikTok”: How this creator is scaling video with AI | Brooke Lacey
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (37 mins) | 🎙️ Brooke Lacey shows live how Claude Code turns a raw phone video into a captioned, jump-cut TikTok in about 15 seconds
summary: Brooke Lacey has been making videos since before Facebook had video, and she built a TikTok audience of more than 290,000 by learning to cut short-form videos herself. With over 25 years in tech, she now builds her own apps, including Zosha, a free mobile app for learning AI.
takeaways: In this episode, Brooke walks me through the Claude Code, FFmpeg, and Whisper workflow that edits her TikToks in about 15 seconds, how she mines her comments for new scripts, and how she runs a weekly short-form operation with no editor.
With over 25 years in tech, she now builds her own apps, including Zosha, a free mobile app for learning AI.
